prereg_reading_deviation: r2 (parent decision 2026-07-25, option (a)): verdict task is 4-class (1 trusted + 3 distractors, p1v3_multi_environment ADD-only module) because 2-class was ceiling-easy for both models in r1 (G==0 structurally).  Donor weakened to qwen3:8b so the donor/receiver quality gap can exist (qwen3:14b aced 2-class; if 8b still aces 4-class the next step is a weaker donor).  train_per_world=3 for deltaW diversity.  Arms/metrics/kills unchanged from the prereg.

donor_freeze.rationale: donor must be weaker than receiver for G to be measurable; qwen3:14b was ceiling-perfect at 2-class in r1, so r2 uses qwen3:8b.

receiver_freeze.note: B frozen; only memory_context varies across arms.

honesty: grounded measurement only; no scientific claim; judgment is the gate's
